name: Agent Status
author: Matteo Moser
description: Shows open Claude Code and Codex sessions with the agent's mark and a live working/done indicator

barWidget.description: Open Claude Code / Codex sessions with working, done and attention state

schema.label: Widget view
schema.description: Use sessions for the pills. Add a second instance to the right bar section and choose detail for the focused conversation topic.

schema.label: Show workspace number
schema.description: Show the terminal’s workspace before its agent logo. Named workspaces show their name instead.

schema.label: Hide session names (compact pills)
schema.description: Keep the workspace badge, agent logo and activity indicators, with names available on hover. Fits more pills within the bar width; maxSessions still applies. Does not hide the right-hand detail.

schema.label: Maximum visible pills
schema.description: Choose 1–12 pills (default 4). Additional sessions appear in a +n pill. Compact mode fits more pills; available screen space may reduce the number shown.

schema.label: Show active conversation detail
schema.description: Enable the detail view. Shows the focused agent’s conversation title and project, not its latest action. Has no effect in the sessions view.

schema.label: Highlight the active session
schema.description: Give the focused terminal a strong outline and bold label, keeping its pill visible even when other sessions overflow.

schema.label: Maximum conversation detail width
schema.description: Maximum width of the detail view in pixels; also capped at a quarter of the screen. Hover to read the complete topic.

schema.label: Maximum session name width
schema.description: Longer session names are elided at this width.

schema.label: Done color
schema.description: Ring, checkmark and pulse once the agent is waiting for you. Hex, rgb() or a theme role such as accent.

schema.label: Attention color
schema.description: Ring while a Codex run reports Waiting, Blocked or Approval. Empty follows the theme's urgent color.

schema.label: Extra terminal app ids
schema.description: Comma-separated app ids to read titles from besides the terminals Omarchy ships, e.g. for a custom omarchy-launch-tui --app-id.
